#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Live MuJoCo view of a MOD4 checkpoint on a Fudan-style stair course."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import math
import time
from pathlib import Path

import mujoco
import numpy as np
import onnxruntime as ort

ROOT = Path(r"D:\claude2\fangzhen")
DEFAULT_XML = ROOT / "incoming" / "rm2025_mod4" / "robot_hifi.xml"
DEFAULT_CONTRACT = ROOT / "incoming" / "chassis_mod4_mjcf_usd_20260910" / "chassis_mod4" / "isaac" / "import_contract.json"
DEFAULT_ONNX = ROOT / "train" / "deploy" / "mod4_fudan_recovery_model2100.onnx"
LEG = ["left_crank", "left_hip", "right_crank", "right_hip"]
WHEEL = ["left_wheel_spin", "right_wheel_spin"]
ACT = LEG + WHEEL
LEG_SCALE = 0.5
WHEEL_SCALE = 10.0
LEG_KP = 60.0
LEG_KD = 2.0
WHEEL_KD = 0.6
LEG_EFF = 40.0
WHEEL_EFF = 5.77590977444
POLICY_HZ = 50.0
PHYSICS_DT = 0.0025
DECIMATION = 8
STEP_HEIGHT = 0.11
STEP_WIDTH = 0.70
STEP_HALF_Y = 1.20
START_X = 3.30
FIRST_RISER_X = 2.40


def parse_args():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument("--onnx", default=str(DEFAULT_ONNX))
    p.add_argument("--xml", default=str(DEFAULT_XML))
    p.add_argument("--contract", default=str(DEFAULT_CONTRACT))
    p.add_argument("--seconds", type=float, default=0.0, help="0 = run until viewer closed")
    p.add_argument("--headless", action="store_true")
    p.add_argument("--cmd-vx", type=float, default=0.75)
    p.add_argument("--cmd-wz", type=float, default=0.0)
    p.add_argument("--height-cmd", type=float, default=0.135)
    p.add_argument("--report", default="")
    return p.parse_args()


class StairPlayer:
    def __init__(self, args):
        self.args = args
        spec = mujoco.MjSpec.from_file(args.xml)
        floor = spec.worldbody.add_geom()
        floor.name = "play_floor"
        floor.type = mujoco.mjtGeom.mjGEOM_PLANE
        floor.size = [12.0, 12.0, 0.1]
        floor.friction = [0.5, 0.005, 0.0001]
        floor.contype = 1
        floor.conaffinity = 1
        floor.rgba = [0.12, 0.14, 0.17, 1.0]

        # Four 0.11 m risers with 0.70 m treads, followed by a raised platform.
        for i in range(4):
            x0 = FIRST_RISER_X - i * STEP_WIDTH
            xc = x0 - 0.5 * STEP_WIDTH
            top = (i + 1) * STEP_HEIGHT
            g = spec.worldbody.add_geom()
            g.name = f"fudan_step_{i+1}"
            g.type = mujoco.mjtGeom.mjGEOM_BOX
            g.size = [0.5 * STEP_WIDTH, STEP_HALF_Y, 0.5 * top]
            g.pos = [xc, 0.0, 0.5 * top]
            g.friction = [0.5, 0.005, 0.0001]
            g.contype = 1
            g.conaffinity = 1
            shade = 0.20 + 0.035 * i
            g.rgba = [shade, shade + 0.07, shade + 0.12, 1.0]
            lip = spec.worldbody.add_geom()
            lip.name = f"step_lip_{i+1}"
            lip.type = mujoco.mjtGeom.mjGEOM_BOX
            lip.size = [0.018, STEP_HALF_Y, 0.010]
            lip.pos = [x0 - 0.018, 0.0, top + 0.010]
            lip.contype = 0
            lip.conaffinity = 0
            lip.rgba = [0.95, 0.48, 0.12, 1.0]

        platform_x0 = FIRST_RISER_X - 4 * STEP_WIDTH
        platform_top = 4 * STEP_HEIGHT
        platform = spec.worldbody.add_geom()
        platform.name = "fudan_upper_platform"
        platform.type = mujoco.mjtGeom.mjGEOM_BOX
        platform.size = [1.60, STEP_HALF_Y, 0.5 * platform_top]
        platform.pos = [platform_x0 - 1.60, 0.0, 0.5 * platform_top]
        platform.friction = [0.5, 0.005, 0.0001]
        platform.contype = 1
        platform.conaffinity = 1
        platform.rgba = [0.30, 0.42, 0.50, 1.0]

        self.m = spec.compile()
        self.m.opt.timestep = PHYSICS_DT
        self.m.vis.headlight.ambient[:] = [0.40, 0.40, 0.40]
        self.m.vis.headlight.diffuse[:] = [0.85, 0.85, 0.85]
        self.m.vis.headlight.specular[:] = [0.20, 0.20, 0.20]
        self.d = mujoco.MjData(self.m)
        self.contract = json.loads(Path(args.contract).read_text(encoding="utf8"))
        self.spawn_height = float(self.contract["spawn_height_m"])
        self.body_names = [mujoco.mj_id2name(self.m, mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_BODY, i) for i in range(self.m.nbody)]
        self.chassis = self.body_names.index("chassis")
        self.qadr = {}
        self.dadr = {}
        self.actuator = {}
        for n in ACT:
            j = mujoco.mj_name2id(self.m, mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_JOINT, n)
            if j < 0:
                raise RuntimeError("missing joint " + n)
            self.qadr[n] = int(self.m.jnt_qposadr[j])
            self.dadr[n] = int(self.m.jnt_dofadr[j])
            a = mujoco.mj_name2id(self.m, mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_ACTUATOR, n + "_motor")
            if a < 0:
                raise RuntimeError("missing actuator " + n + "_motor")
            self.actuator[n] = a
        self.default_leg = np.array([self.m.qpos0[self.qadr[n]] for n in LEG], dtype=np.float64)
        self.sess = ort.InferenceSession(args.onnx, providers=["CPUExecutionProvider"])
        self.input_name = self.sess.get_inputs()[0].name
        self.last_action = np.zeros(6, np.float32)
        self.ctrl_step = 0
        self.min_x = START_X
        self.best_advance_m = 0.0
        self.resets = 0
        self.reset()

    def ground_height(self, x):
        if x > FIRST_RISER_X:
            return 0.0
        for i in range(4):
            upper = FIRST_RISER_X - i * STEP_WIDTH
            lower = upper - STEP_WIDTH
            if lower <= x <= upper:
                return (i + 1) * STEP_HEIGHT
        return 4 * STEP_HEIGHT

    def reset(self):
        mujoco.mj_resetData(self.m, self.d)
        self.d.qpos[:] = self.m.qpos0
        self.d.qvel[:] = 0.0
        self.d.ctrl[:] = 0.0
        self.d.qpos[0] = START_X
        self.d.qpos[1] = 0.0
        self.d.qpos[2] = self.spawn_height
        self.d.qpos[3:7] = [1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
        mujoco.mj_forward(self.m, self.d)
        self.last_action[:] = 0.0
        self.ctrl_step = 0
        self.min_x = START_X

    def observation(self):
        o = np.zeros(35, np.float32)
        o[0] = self.args.cmd_vx
        o[1] = 0.0
        o[2] = self.args.cmd_wz
        o[3] = self.args.height_cmd * 5.0
        R = self.d.xmat[self.chassis].reshape(3, 3)
        o[4:7] = (R.T @ self.d.qvel[3:6]) * 0.5
        o[7:10] = R.T @ np.array([0.0, 0.0, -1.0], dtype=float)
        leg_q = np.array([self.d.qpos[self.qadr[n]] for n in LEG])
        o[10:14] = leg_q - self.default_leg
        o[14:16] = 0.0
        o[16:20] = [self.d.qvel[self.dadr[n]] * 0.1 for n in LEG]
        o[20:22] = [self.d.qvel[self.dadr[n]] * 0.1 for n in WHEEL]
        o[22:28] = self.last_action
        o[28] = 1.0
        return o

    def infer(self):
        raw = self.sess.run(None, {self.input_name: self.observation().reshape(1, 35)})[0][0].astype(np.float32)
        self.last_action = raw
        for i, n in enumerate(LEG):
            target = self.default_leg[i] + float(raw[i]) * LEG_SCALE
            tau = LEG_KP * (target - self.d.qpos[self.qadr[n]]) - LEG_KD * self.d.qvel[self.dadr[n]]
            self.d.ctrl[self.actuator[n]] = float(np.clip(tau, -LEG_EFF, LEG_EFF))
        for i, n in enumerate(WHEEL):
            target_v = float(raw[4 + i]) * WHEEL_SCALE
            tau = WHEEL_KD * (target_v - self.d.qvel[self.dadr[n]])
            self.d.ctrl[self.actuator[n]] = float(np.clip(tau, -WHEEL_EFF, WHEEL_EFF))

    def step_control(self):
        self.infer()
        for _ in range(DECIMATION):
            mujoco.mj_step(self.m, self.d)
        self.ctrl_step += 1
        x = float(self.d.qpos[0])
        self.min_x = min(self.min_x, x)
        self.best_advance_m = max(self.best_advance_m, START_X - self.min_x)
        if self.tilt_deg() > 70.0 or self.d.qpos[2] < self.ground_height(x) + 0.07:
            self.resets += 1
            self.reset()

    def tilt_deg(self):
        R = self.d.xmat[self.chassis].reshape(3, 3)
        up = R.T @ np.array([0.0, 0.0, 1.0])
        return math.degrees(math.acos(float(np.clip(up[2], -1.0, 1.0))))

    def status(self):
        x = float(self.d.qpos[0])
        return dict(
            t_s=self.ctrl_step / POLICY_HZ,
            x=x,
            y=float(self.d.qpos[1]),
            z=float(self.d.qpos[2]),
            local_height=float(self.d.qpos[2] - self.ground_height(x)),
            tilt_deg=self.tilt_deg(),
            min_x=float(self.min_x),
            max_advance_m=float(self.best_advance_m),
            step_top=float(self.ground_height(x)),
            resets=int(self.resets),
        )


def main():
    args = parse_args()
    p = StairPlayer(args)
    start = time.perf_counter()
    next_t = start
    if args.headless:
        steps = int(round(args.seconds * POLICY_HZ)) if args.seconds > 0 else 500
        for _ in range(steps):
            p.step_control()
            if p.ctrl_step % 50 == 0:
                print(json.dumps(p.status()), flush=True)
    else:
        import mujoco.viewer as mv
        with mv.launch_passive(p.m, p.d) as viewer:
            viewer.cam.type = mujoco.mjtCamera.mjCAMERA_TRACKING
            viewer.cam.trackbodyid = p.chassis
            viewer.cam.distance = 2.8
            viewer.cam.elevation = -16.0
            viewer.cam.azimuth = 135.0
            while viewer.is_running():
                now = time.perf_counter()
                if args.seconds > 0 and now - start >= args.seconds:
                    break
                p.step_control()
                viewer.sync()
                if p.ctrl_step % 50 == 0:
                    print(json.dumps(p.status()), flush=True)
                next_t += 1.0 / POLICY_HZ
                dt = next_t - time.perf_counter()
                if dt > 0:
                    time.sleep(dt)
    result = p.status()
    result.update({"onnx": args.onnx, "xml": args.xml, "course": "fudan_style_stairs_0.11m"})
    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
    if args.report:
        Path(args.report).write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2), encoding="utf8")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
